_comment: LEGACY / NO LONGER READ (as of 2026-07-24) -- fetch_conditions.fetch_fire_status() now sources fire restriction stage and wildfire-proximity data from govallecito.com's own Worker (govallecito-conditions.dkontje.workers.dev), the same backend the website itself reads from, instead of this file. This file is kept only as a historical record -- editing it no longer changes what the bot posts, and no longer triggers the emergency-alert workflow (its push-trigger path was updated to stop watching this file). If you ever want to go back to hand-maintaining fire status here instead of trusting the Worker, that's a one-line code change in fetch_conditions.fetch_fire_status() -- ask Claude.
source: San Juan National Forest / La Plata County

nearby_wildfires._comment: Optional. Set count to 0 to omit the situational line entirely. If you set a count > 0, write the whole 'note' sentence yourself -- the bot posts it verbatim, it does not calculate distances.
